ShipWeight

ShipWeight supports weight estimation, tracking and centre-of-gravity control through a vessel lifecycle.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Build a weight estimate

Begin with the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended ShipWeight preview, build a weight estimate; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Track design weight changes

Use the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended ShipWeight preview, track design weight changes; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Report centres and margins

Start from the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended ShipWeight preview, report centres and margins; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
